description: Unit tests for authentication hashing utilities including v1/v2 hashing, verification, migration, and tenant orgSalt management.

methods.name: getPepper
methods.description: Retrieves the pepper value used in password hashing from environment variables.

methods.name: hashPasswordV1
methods.description: Hashes a password using legacy method with SECRET_SALT.

methods.name: hashPasswordV2
methods.description: Hashes a password using v2 method considering tenant orgSalt and optional pepper.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Verifies a candidate password against stored hash, considering versioning and tenant info.

methods.name: ensureTenantOrgSalt
methods.description: Ensures that the tenant object has a generated orgSalt, possibly persisting it.

methods.name: hashPassword
methods.description: Wrapper function that defaults to v2 hashing, respecting tenant orgSalt and pepper.

methods.name: verifyAndMigrate
methods.description: Verifies password and facilitates migration from legacy v1 to v2 hashes if applicable.
